item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 14/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, it will be generally fine and windier over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The monsoon will moderate slightly over the weekend. Temperatures will rise over the coastal areas. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. It will be cool in the morning over the region.
